correctness.rationale: Every one can be flipped down, so the degree is n minus the count of zeros completing a triple after a flip. The thirteen legal length-four states and two zero sentinels on each side implement the five-bit blocking rule: each append scores the real position two places before the append, including the final two positions during sentinel appends. This gives the stated rational transfer including the separately handled empty and one-bit words. A double one-run accounts for at most two blocked zeros; those not touching any double run occur only in single-zero gaps between singleton runs, of which there are at most r1−1 when r1>0. Thus the number blocked is at most both the zero count and the one count, with strictness against the one count in the presence of singleton runs. Equality at even n forces only double runs and an exact distinct flank on each side of every double, hence (0110) repeated; this is impossible for n=2 mod 4. The four displayed witnesses attain their bounds, including n=1,2,3. At n≥3 full degree is equivalent to all ones being spaced at least three positions apart; delete two padding zeros between successive ones to obtain the stated binomial count, handling the empty set separately. At n=1,2 all flips are legal.
residual_risks: The reported finite checks were not relied on as a reproduced run. The transfer, sharp bounds and equality cases were checked by proof for all linear lengths.
There is no conclusion for cyclic words or graph connectivity.

evidence: The first lemma plus a spacing count gives the maximum-degree multiplicity. Edge counts are the first moment of degrees, while the transfer weights blocked zeros position by position and the equality proof forces alternating double runs and their distinct flanks.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Full-degree characterization alone does not imply either the histogram or rigidity of its opposite extreme. Induced cube counts are not degree-star counts: a set of individually legal flips need not span a legal cube (e.g. all three flips from 000), so the cube polynomial is not the ordinary degree enumerator.

originality.rationale: The distinctive claim is the all-length ordinary-degree histogram and exact minimum-degree law including rigidity at multiples of four. The full-degree local criterion has a known formulation, and the spacing count is an elementary consequence, not the basis for the originality decision. The strongest accessible material does not provide the distinctive joint result; the 2020 article's inaccessible body limits historical confidence.
residual_risks: The 2020 Tribonacci enumerative article is a plausible source of an equivalent refinement; only the abstract was inspected, and full historical priority is not established.
The elementary maximum-degree spacing specialization is not counted as a standalone advance.

value.rationale: An exact distribution of legal one-coordinate changes and its smallest value are natural local robustness invariants of this established graph family, not captured by its vertex/edge totals. The sharp mod-four defect and the unique tight vertex in the divisible-by-four case answer concrete structural questions; the weighted finite transfer permits exact degree multiplicities at all lengths.
residual_risks: The transfer is a constant-size representation rather than a minimal closed form. No inference to connectivity or to other forbidden factors is made.
